exposure: Women were grouped into 'Nulliparous term cephalic', 'Previous cesarean section' and 'Other Robson' (Robson groups 6, 7, 8 or 10).
Robson group (Nulliparous term cephalic, Previous cesarean section, Other Robson)
cohort: 1818 women with induced labor and no prior vaginal birth
finding: Cesarean section rates and methods used for labor induction varied widely, but neonatal outcomes were similar to those of normal birth populations.
gest_age: Term for nulliparous women, other gestational ages not specified
